coverage.limitations: No complete canonical positive forward or resident source scanner. Reduced integrated proof regression remains CPU/small-profile and does not certify the new adapter. Arc identity is not cryptographic W commitment binding or snapshot lifecycle binding. Runtime C statistics exclude Rust metadata.
